caption: A tracker counts one thing at a time. HealthGraph keeps the thread instead: the visit next to the pulse, the pulse next to the day. Not isolated numbers, but your health history as connected context, growing as you live. Wellness info only, not medical advice. Discover HealthGraph at healthgraph.shop. #healthgraph #healthhistory #healthapp #digitalhealth #selfcare #healthdata #personalhealth #wellness #selftracking #connectedhistory

lines.beat: Title card with wordmark, calm hold

lines.text: A tracker counts one thing at a time.
lines.beat: Single metric labels drift past in isolation

lines.text: Sleep here, food there, steps somewhere else.
lines.beat: SLEEP, FOOD, STEPS labels adrift, not connected

lines.text: It tells you where you stand today.

lines.text: It rarely shows you where you've been.

lines.text: This is a connected history instead.
lines.beat: Transition: fragments line up toward the center

lines.text: Every entry sits next to the others.

lines.text: The visit connects to the pulse.
lines.beat: health-graph: edge draws from the visit node to the heart node

lines.text: The pulse connects to the day.
